newsitem.title: USA: US NAM President says 110 proper level for dlr/yen.
newsitem.headline: US NAM President says 110 proper level for dlr/yen.

text.p: National Association of Manufacturers President Jerry Jasinowski said on Wednesday that the dollar trading above 110 yen creates problems for U.S. manufacturers.
"Most people at 110 or so were not raising flags," Jasinowski said at a briefing. "As it moved above that you heard increasingly that it was a major issue."
The yen is currently quoted against the dollar at just over 116.
